(c) Propagation step involving formation of CH3Cl is exothermic as bond is formed between CCl

(d) + HCl, H4 = 103 kcal/mol

Enthalpy of reaction, H = H + H + H + H

= 58 + 105 85 103

= 25 kcal mol1

Hence, the reaction is exothermic with H = 25 kcal/mol
